title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode5 Ordinary Scenery

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Converted cafe

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting.

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customer
rows.Line: That was a really nice cafe!

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customer
rows.Line: Yeah, the tea and anmitsu were both really good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seems like we should be able to get inside soon...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see what this cafe's like.
You found this one, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, in one of the magazines.
This cafe was apparently renovated from an old Japanese-style house.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It even has a long porch that runs adjacent to the garden, which means we'll be able to have some tea while enjoying the greenery.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tea by a garden... That sounds exquisitely Japanese! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
You're our group of four, yes? Please follow me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, we get to go in.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here are your seats.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, interesting. We're supposed to sit by letting our feet hang outside over the edge...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And they really did take an old house and turn it into a cafe.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It actually kinda feels like our house...
But I've been to a cafe that felt like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... I think they're going to place our tea on these tables and trays, so why don't we all sit side by side and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: It's really by the gardeeeeeen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're both that moved...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean!
I've never been to a cafe where you let your feet hang over the edge while gazing at a garden!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me neither...!
I was completely under the impression that there'd be tables and chairs! To think that we'd be sitting on the floor like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We get to enjoy this lovely breeze while having tea... How fantastic is that?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you two like it here so much.
Then, why don't we sit in pairs and place a table between us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's sunny, nice... And I'm having such a great time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could do something like this at home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would be nice to relax as a family at home like this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Based on what this cafe has to offer...
What if we had tea on the veranda?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
We should ask Mom and Dad about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would be nice to give them a chance to relax for a change!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They seem to be enjoying themselves quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, so I guess this place is a hit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Anyway, enough about them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Open wide, Shii. Say, “Ahh.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not happening.
I don't need your help with my anmitsu.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you've hardly eaten any of yours.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's not true. And really, I'm feeling very full after watching you enjoy your treat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There you go again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's been so long since we spent time together like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were so busy preparing for that festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But you know...
We could do something like this at our house...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we have a porch like this at home, so we could have tea there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we can't really see much beyond the walls around the garden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think enjoying people-watching and gazing at the scenery is the best part of this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Is it really that big of a difference? I don't really get it, myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
For example, that family over there.
They seem very close, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The little girl is tugging on her father's hand. She seems so eager to get to where they're going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's pulling so hard that it almost looks painful...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's right. There are a lot of different people here.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Those people over there seem like a group of friends. They're having fun taking pictures together...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The person next to them is having yakitori alone. Is it from the stall over there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh, three pieces in one bite...
That's starting to look really good.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't this look like a piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. All these different people are here enjoying this village and making their own precious memories...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You can see all that just by sitting here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why this view feels like art to me, and I think it's really wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A view that looks like art, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I never would've thought of it that way.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (From my perspective, I just saw a bunch of people going about their daily business...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... It is a nice view.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, Shih's smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(She seems more relaxed than usual.
This is perfect☆)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And having tea by a garden like this seems like so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I should ask Len to see if we can do something like this in SEKAI☆)
